rationale: Repair of the concrete failure documented in inputs/previous-feedback.txt: the accepted BN-fold bundle (trial-d2a4cb48d3, paired win only ~46 us of the ~428 us of removed cudnn::bn_fw_inf kernels) left the eager cudnn path paying every folded conv bias as a separate NON-VECTORIZED broadcast elementwise kernel (call-resources.json revision 353b783e: 20 add kernels, 355.9 us total, 206.6 us alone after the stem conv on the [32,64,112,112] output; grid 100352x128 unvectorized CUDAFunctor_add), plus 17 separate aten::relu kernels (350.9 us) and 8 residual aten::add_ kernels (77.3 us) - ~784 us of pointwise epilogue traffic against ~2974 us of conv kernels, on an invocation the current execution_timeline shows GPU-compute-bound (kernel active union 3989.5 us inside a 4071.0 us span, 81.5 us launch gaps, host self-time ~0). Only kernel-time removal can move latency_ms. This joint bundle explicitly replaces the whole accepted fold bundle at every site it declared (17 ResNetConvLayer + 3 ResNetShortCut module calls) and additionally takes over the 8 ResNetBasicLayer boundaries (groups 5233e425bbe8203a4dc0, 5eb0dee1d36938317bbe, c1271430eda49ac23557, 9f7c0638f7c2fd3e7c50), transferring required-call coverage to these replacements: (a) the 9 ReLU-terminated conv sites (stem fad32b28bd6e0def6ce7593e + the 8 layer.0 first convs) execute the BN-folded conv as ONE aten::cudnn_convolution_relu kernel (registered CUDA kernel verified in the worker torch 2.13.0+cu129 registry; the production ConvReLU2d fused path using cudnnConvolutionBiasActivationForward), eliminating the broadcast bias-add and the separate ReLU at those sites; (b) the 8 activation=None second convs and 3 shortcut convs emit the folded conv with bias=None (one conv kernel, no elementwise bias pass) when invoked inside their owning basic layer's fused window and hand the folded bias to the owner; (c) each ResNetBasicLayer replacement still calls its real child module boundaries (self.layer Sequential and self.shortcut, including the 5 nn.Identity shortcuts) so ALL 28 declared replacements execute on every invocation with no counter-filling dummy work, then computes ReLU(hidden + residual + b_conv2 + b_shortcut) as ONE vectorized Triton kernel (eager relu(x+r+b) fallback if Triton is unavailable), replacing conv2's bias-add, the shortcut's bias-add, the add_ and the post-add ReLU. Coordination is fail-safe: a per-physical-module window marker decides bias-free emission, and the epilogue adds back exactly the biases the children reported as not applied, so any guard rejection or per-site runtime failure (including the fused cudnn op raising on a specific shape, per-site sticky fallback to conv+bias then activation) degrades to the accepted bundle's behavior with unchanged outputs. Numerics are the same FP32 adds/ReLU in a different association order (relu(x_nobias + r + b_sum) vs relu((x_nobias+b2)+(r+bsc))): CPU pre-validation with the frozen weights, the exact fold arithmetic, all 28 replacements installed and the full batch=32 fixture input reproduces the 1000-class logits with max_abs_err=7.63e-6 (bound: atol=rtol=1e-4, prior accepted fold itself measured 9.5e-6 on GPU, reference top1-top2 margin 0.1446), exact top-1 preserved, bit-stable across repeated runs; guard fallbacks (grad enabled) return outputs bit-identical to the parent path, and standalone conv2/shortcut invocation outside the fused window reproduces the parent site output within 4.8e-6. Expected effect: removes up to ~0.70 ms of pointwise kernel time (355.9 us bias-adds + 350.9 us relus + 77.3 us add_) and adds back ~0.08-0.12 ms of Triton epilogue traffic (one 3-tensor pass over the 8 layer outputs, ~96 MB total) plus ~0 for the cudnn bias/relu epilogues, targeting latency_ms ~4.18 -> ~3.5-3.7 with images_per_second (exact reciprocal) rising proportionally; peak_allocated_bytes stays at the accepted fold's level (folded copies replace that bundle's, one epilogue output replaces the old relu output). These are hypotheses the framework's paired A/B must confirm, not predicted acceptance; launch-register data is not treated as occupancy or causal evidence. Eliminated inner calls are all inside replaced boundaries and their consumers receive identical values from the fused kernels: the 9 conv1/stem aten::conv2d functional sites are superseded by the fused conv+bias+relu op, the 9 conv-site ReLU module sites and their 9 aten::relu children are applied inside that op, the 8 conv2 Identity activation sites and the 8 ResNetBasicLayer-final ReLU module sites with their 8 aten::relu children and 8 aten::add_ residual sites are computed by the single fused epilogue kernel. The Sequential layer sites, the 5 Identity shortcut sites and the 8 conv2/shortcut aten::conv2d sites keep executing (now bias-free conv). previous-feedback.txt otherwise changes this attempt by ruling out host-side and launch-gap strategies (GPU-bound invocation), by supplying the per-site kernel evidence that motivated exactly these epilogue fusions, and by warning that reference counters only observe declared boundaries - hence children are invoked through their real module callables.

setup_work.description: One-time work at build/installation, outside the timed invocation; no model parameters or BN buffers are modified.
steps: Exact eval-mode BN fold of all 20 conv/BN pairs (scale=gamma/sqrt(running_var+eps), W'=W*scale, b'=beta-scale*running_mean) into contiguous FP32 CUDA copies, folded once per physical conv module and shared between the conv site replacement and its owning basic layer (~11.2M params, ~45 MB; replaces the superseded bundle's folded copies).
Per-channel epilogue bias tensors: zeros(C), b_conv2, b_shortcut (3 sites) and b_conv2+b_shortcut sums; negligible size.

Synthetic-device probes on the leased worker GPU at install (no fixture data): a 1x3x4x8 cudnn_convolution_relu correctness probe against relu(center-tap conv) and a 1x8x2x4 Triton epilogue probe checked against the eager formula; a failed probe latches the eager/two-op fallback paths before the first invocation.

Lazy Triton JIT compilation of the single fp32 add+bias+relu kernel on the first quality invocations (one compile, cached for all 8 layers and all later invocations; worst case a few hundred ms inside the untimed quality/warmup phase, well within the 900 s worker timeout).
setup_work.setup_memory: Folded weight/bias copies ~45 MB allocated during installation and retained for the warm-model lifetime (same footprint class as the superseded fold bundle; reported by lifecycle counters, not by the per-run peak_allocated_bytes reset). No CUDA Graph pools, no persistent runtime buffers beyond the [C] bias vectors.
setup_work.state_lifecycle: Inference-only: replacements are stateless per invocation apart from the per-module coordination marker (reset in a finally block around each child call window) and sticky per-site fallback latches; adapter.reset()/eval() semantics unaffected; no parameter updates, no gradients (guards reject grad-enabled calls to the parent).

quality_risks: cudnn_convolution_relu may pick a different conv algorithm for some shapes (cudnn.benchmark=False heuristics), shifting FP32 rounding; bounded by the 1e-4 tolerance against the 7.63e-6 CPU-validated error and the 0.1446 top1-top2 margin, but only the framework's independent GPU quality check confirms it.

If the fused cudnn op raises on a specific real shape despite the install probe passing, that site sticky-falls back to folded conv+bias followed by the unchanged activation module: correct output, partial speed loss, visible via the folded_conv_relu_two_op route label.
If Triton compilation fails in the worker, all 8 epilogues use the eager relu(x+r+b) path: correct output, ~0.1 ms less benefit, visible via basic_fused_epilogue_eager labels.

Bias re-association (x+r+b_sum vs (x+b2)+(r+bsc)) adds FP32 rounding of the same magnitude as the accepted fold (measured 7.63e-6 max on full logits in CPU pre-validation); the negative control and exact top-1 are re-verified by the framework, not assumed.

Coordinated bias-free conv2/shortcut emission is only consumed by the owning basic-layer replacement's epilogue; every other caller (guard rejection, framework reference invocation, standalone call) gets the full parent-faithful output because the marker window is closed - validated in CPU pre-validation with bit-identical fallback outputs.

Coverage: all 28 declared replacements execute on every invocation through real module boundaries (children are called via self.layer/self.shortcut, not reimplemented in place), so required-call coverage does not depend on eliminated inner functional sites.
